title: 弗莱彻（USS Fletcher DD-445） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. US destroyer deckhouses, two upright separated funnels, a compact enclosed bridge and a tripod mast recall USS Fletcher DD-445.
targetArmament: Four single main mounts follow TARGET; the historical Fletcher silhouette had five single 5-inch positions. No fifth working or decorative gun is added.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
